summary: US-midterm shockwaves dominated the week: an AI-stock rout deepened the DRAM/NAND cost squeeze on Indian EMS assemblers while Iran de-escalation hopes knocked Brent down ~18% before a partial rebound, fading the energy-security tailwind. Domestically, four decided Cabinet/DGTR/order-book actions this week — grid-storage VGF, critical-mineral processing capex support, a ₹28,000cr BHEL thermal order, and a soda-ash safeguard — open four new, narrowly-scoped tailwinds, while a Paras–BroadPak OSAT tie-up adds a fresh name to the semis theme.

themes.name: Grid-scale energy storage (VGF scheme)
themes.thesis: A dated, costed Rs 14,500 crore viability-gap-funding scheme de-risks 92 GWh of new pumped-hydro and battery storage capacity (Rs 97,600 crore total investment, FY27-31), directly subsidising the capex of storage-cell makers and project developers who bid into it.

drivers.what: Cabinet approved Rs 14,500 crore VGF scheme for 92 GWh grid-scale storage (60 GWh pumped hydro, 30 GWh BESS, 2 GWh other) targeting 411 GWh cumulative by FY32

beneficiaries.mechanism: Exide Energy Solutions' 12 GWh lithium-cell gigafactory (Bengaluru) is a direct domestic BESS-cell supplier positioned to fill VGF-backed storage tenders
Amara Raja's Rs 9,500 crore, 16 GWh Telangana Giga Corridor targets grid/BESS demand the VGF scheme is designed to catalyse
60 of the 92 GWh is pumped-hydro storage (PSP) capacity; NHPC is a PSU pumped-hydro developer with an existing project pipeline that can draw VGF support directly
JSW Energy's storage and pumped-hydro project pipeline qualifies for the new VGF capital support, lowering its project IRR hurdle
As the dedicated RE/storage lender, IREDA's loan book grows as developers draw financing to build out VGF-subsidised storage capacity
Hybrid renewable-plus-storage developer whose storage-linked PPAs become more bankable once VGF narrows the viability gap

themes.name: Critical mineral processing & recycling
themes.thesis: A dated Cabinet capex-support scheme directly subsidises domestic lithium/nickel processing plants (up to Rs 500-900 crore per plant), and a fresh critical-mineral block auction widens the ore-supply pipeline — together de-risking the capex of India's handful of secondary/critical-metal processors.

drivers.what: Cabinet approved Rs 2,814 crore Capex Support Scheme to Promote Critical Mineral Processing (lithium/nickel), targeting 60kt lithium + 100kt nickel processing capacity and Rs 10,000 crore of investment, FY27-31
Government offered 20 critical mineral blocks across 8 states in the ninth auction tranche
drivers.source: BusinessLine headline from briefing: "India offers 20 critical mineral blocks across 8 states in ninth auction tranche"

beneficiaries.mechanism: Already running a 6,000 MTPA lithium-ion battery recycling plant at Mundra with a Rs 1,700 crore roadmap to 800,000 MTPA secondary-processing capacity by FY29 — exactly the domestic processing capacity the new capex-support scheme is designed to catalyse
Non-ferrous metal (copper/lead/aluminium) recycler adjacent to the government's secondary-processing push for strategic metals, though its current capacity isn't lithium/nickel-specific
Copper is on India's critical-minerals list; HINDCOPPER is a plausible bidder in the new mineral-block auction tranche, though no specific award is yet confirmed
beneficiaries.evidence: BusinessLine headline from briefing: "India offers 20 critical mineral blocks across 8 states in ninth auction tranche"

themes.name: Thermal & nuclear power equipment order cycle
themes.thesis: A dated, Rs 28,000 crore BTG (boiler-turbine-generator) order from Adani Power to BHEL, alongside NTPC's decided plan to add 58 GW of capacity (including a stepped-up ~30 GW nuclear ambition) by 2032-37, confirms a multi-year thermal-plus-nuclear EPC order cycle feeding listed power-equipment makers.

drivers.what: BHEL won orders worth up to Rs 28,000 crore from Adani Power for four 2x800MW (6,400MW total) thermal projects, covering boilers, turbines, generators and auxiliary equipment
NTPC targets 149 GW installed capacity by 2032 (+58 GW), with chairman outlining ~30 GW nuclear ambition by 2037 and feasibility studies completed in MP, Bihar and Odisha

beneficiaries.mechanism: Direct, named EPC/BTG contractor on the Rs 28,000 crore Adani Power order, its single largest disclosed order win this year
Supplies boilers and auxiliary equipment into the same thermal-capacity build-out cycle that BHEL's order confirms is accelerating
Turbine-generator component supplier benefiting from the broader thermal/industrial power order momentum
Special alloys/forgings supplier positioned to benefit as NTPC's nuclear-grade component sourcing ramps toward its 2037 nuclear ambition
Precision investment castings for nuclear/aerospace-grade components, an adjacent beneficiary of NTPC's nuclear capacity push

themes.name: Soda ash import safeguard
themes.thesis: DGTR found soda ash imports up 89% in 2023-24 causing serious injury and recommended a two-year quantitative-restriction safeguard; this directly protects the pricing power of the domestic soda-ash producers who filed the case, pending final Department of Revenue notification.

drivers.what: DGTR recommended a two-year safeguard (quantitative restriction) on soda ash imports — quota of 754,992 MT in year 1, 792,740 MT in year 2 — after a petition by the Alkali Manufacturers Association on behalf of DCW, GHCL, Nirma, RSPL and Ta

beneficiaries.mechanism: Named petitioner and India's largest listed soda-ash producer; the import quota directly shields its domestic soda-ash pricing and volumes from a documented 89% import surge

themes.name: Semiconductors & OSAT
themes.thesis: A new, decided private-sector tie-up adds an advanced-packaging/OSAT capability inside the universe, broadening the theme beyond its existing EMS-adjacent members even as the global AI-chip rout (see EMS) creates short-term noise around semis sentiment generally.

drivers.what: Paras Semiconductors (subsidiary of Paras Defence) partnered with US-based BroadPak Corp to build an advanced heterogeneous-integration/3D-packaging OSAT facility in India (2.5D/3D packaging, chiplet integration, hybrid bonding, co-packaged

beneficiaries.mechanism: Direct new OSAT/advanced-packaging business line via the BroadPak technology partnership, a new revenue vertical outside its core defence-optics business

themes.name: Electronics manufacturing (EMS)
themes.thesis: The global memory (DRAM/NAND) cost shock flagged last week has now converted into realised, brokerage-quantified margin and volume cuts at the most exposed assembler, and was compounded this week by an AI-driven Nasdaq chip rout that hit the same global supply chain, even after a partial rebound.

drivers.what: CLSA flags Dixon as most exposed in EMS to the memory price surge; Jefferies forecasts a 31% drop in Dixon's CY26 global smartphone shipments; Dixon's own Q4 showed revenue +2.1% but profit -36% on cost pressure
Worst US stock rout since 2020: Nasdaq plunged 6.4%, Micron -17%, AMD/Qualcomm/SanDisk down up to 17%, $2.5 trillion wiped off US equities, before a partial Nasdaq +2% rebound after midterm results
drivers.source: BusinessLine headline from briefing: "Worst US stock rout since 2020 leaves virtually nowhere to hide as Nasdaq plunges 6.4%, Dow sheds 1,833 points"

beneficiaries.mechanism: Smartphone-heavy EMS mix is most exposed to memory cost pass-through; brokerages have already cut shipment and earnings estimates on this specific driver
White-goods-weighted EMS mix is less memory-intensive than smartphones, so the cost hit is milder but still present across the sector
Consumer-electronics EMS assembler exposed to the same component cost inflation sweeping the sector
Consumer-electronics EMS assembler exposed to the same component cost inflation sweeping the sector

themes.name: Financial market infrastructure
themes.thesis: A cluster of decided SEBI actions this week continues to strip friction from foreign and domestic capital flows — digital KYC for NRIs/FPIs without an India visit, net settlement for MF cash trades, and higher currency-derivative limits — each pushing incremental volume toward listed depositories, RTAs and exchanges.

drivers.what: SEBI eased KYC norms for NRIs, OCIs and foreign nationals, allowing fully digital onboarding without an India visit
drivers.source: BusinessLine headline from briefing: "SEBI eases KYC rules for overseas investors, allows digital onboarding without India visit"

drivers.what: SEBI approved net settlement of cash-market fund trades for mutual funds, effective April
drivers.source: The Economic Times headline from briefing: "Sebi approves net settlement of cash market trades for mutual funds"

drivers.what: SEBI revised currency derivative norms, raising the domestic investor/FPI position limit to $5 million
drivers.source: NDTV Profit headline from briefing: "SEBI Eases Currency Derivatives Rules, Sets $5 Million Limit"

beneficiaries.mechanism: Depository account-opening and transaction volumes rise as FPI/NRI onboarding friction falls
beneficiaries.evidence: BusinessLine headline from briefing: "SEBI eases KYC rules for overseas investors, allows digital onboarding without India visit"

beneficiaries.mechanism: RTA transaction volumes benefit from smoother, net-settled mutual-fund cash-market processing
beneficiaries.evidence: The Economic Times headline from briefing: "Sebi approves net settlement of cash market trades for mutual funds"

beneficiaries.mechanism: Higher currency-derivative position limits support exchange turnover and open interest
beneficiaries.evidence: NDTV Profit headline from briefing: "SEBI Eases Currency Derivatives Rules, Sets $5 Million Limit"

themes.name: West Asia energy security / crude price
themes.thesis: Last week's strength-5 thesis (sustained high crude lifting upstream realisations while raising freight/input costs elsewhere) is fading: Brent fell roughly 18% from its 30 October high to its 5 November low on US-midterm-driven Iran de-escalation hopes, though it partially rebounded ~6% as Hormuz tanker attacks persisted — leaving the direction genuinely mixed rather than a clean tailwind or headwind.

drivers.what: Brent crude fell ~18% from the 30 October high to the 5 November low on hopes of US-brokered Iran de-escalation following the Democratic midterm sweep, before rebounding ~6% as Hormuz tanker attacks continued

beneficiaries.mechanism: Upstream realisation tailwind fades as Brent retreats from the $109-120 highs cited last week toward the $93-100 range
Forced shift to delivered-basis crude purchases to manage Hormuz-linked shipping risk is a persistent cost/margin headwind independent of the spot price move
beneficiaries.evidence: The Economic Times headline from briefing: "MRPL boosts delivered oil buying as Iran war raises shipping risks"

outside_universe.why: Named petitioner alongside Tata Chemicals in the DGTR soda-ash safeguard case and a direct beneficiary, but the GHCL entity in the universe (GHCLTEXTIL) is only the demerged textile arm.
SEBI-cleared IPO for a defence-electronics/thermal-imaging maker riding the same procurement tailwind as listed defelec names, but not yet listed.
Launched the Navy's Fleet Support Ship-1 this week, a direct naval-shipbuilding beneficiary, but it is a government shipyard not listed on the exchange.
CCI cleared a KKR-led investment into this Petronas-backed renewables platform, a large new capital pool entering India's RE build-out, but the entity is unlisted.
Plans to deploy $12-15bn into Indian data-centre capacity by 2032, a major demand signal for the theme, but the platform itself is not a listed universe name.
